notes.title: FUIght Club Update 25/09/2024
notes.notes:
EqUIp yourself for vicotry, bUIld your own arena and pursUI victory with the new upgraded interface!

I'm happy to share the latest improvements with you.

I. The battles are more appealing. 

 attacking feels better thanks to the new visual feedback with weapon trails
 while the power of your attacks pushes your opponent back
 and with enough skill, you can also backstab your opponent 


II. The improved user interface is clearer. 

 the health bar in particular has been revised
 more menus already feature the new style of gold and marble


And left, right and center many small bug fixes. Especially for the hidden quests ... have fun discovering them ;)

notes.title: NotJustOneRing Update 03.09.2024
notes.notes:
The loot system has been completely overhauled to make victories even more rewarding! Get ready for a much more motivating experience as you conquer your enemies and claim their treasures. With so many new powerful rings to choose from, deciding which one to wear just became really hard. Chose wisely and dominate the arena 
The new loot system opens up a whole new level of customization, allowing you to tailor your play style like never before. Forge your own path to victory! But there's much more: the latest update brings a fully reworked upgrade system, improved balancing, and bug fixes. Your path to glory has never been smoother or more satisfying!

notes.title: Patch notes: custom controls
notes.notes:
Controls:
- implemented functionality to customize the controls
- context-sensitive UI elements for game pad and keyboard/mouse
- menu navigation should be more fluid

New Features:
- weapons have unique special attacks

Misc:
- minor bug fixing e.g. localization mistakes
- minor alterations of the slave AI
- minor extension of the tutorial e.g. where is the arena or the blocking mechanics of shields
- more distinct "back" buttons for the menus of the manager part
- reduced the penalty for getting killed so that you can always get your starting gear back
